market_definition: The polymethacrylimide foam market comprises rigid, closed-cell foams with very high strength-to-weight ratio, used as cores for high-performance sandwich composites. It measures sales of PMI blocks, sheets and cut kits. BY DENSITY: < 75 kg/m³, 75–110 kg/m³, > 110 kg/m³. BY PRODUCT FORM: Blocks, Sheets, Machined Kits. BY PROCESSING GRADE: Standard, High-Temperature (Autoclave). BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Aerospace & Defense, Automotive Lightweighting, Wind & Marine, Medical Imaging & Sports, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: PVC, PET and PEI foams; acrylic polymer sold unfoamed; honeycomb cores. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
